summary: Need a single-unit 'next up from chosen target' mode (native NextUpFromTarget; enemyNextDown exists, enemyAboveTarget is all above) or per-target chance on status segments. Native 8485: CauseSilence@FromTarget, @NextUpFromTarget, @NextDownFromTarget, each an independent 30% roll. Curated can only write inflict(chosen,0.3)+inflict(enemyChosenAndAdjacent,0.3): segment chance is one roll for the whole segment, so both neighbours are silenced together or not at all. Fix in curated after primitive: silence chosen 0.3, enemyNextUp 0.3, enemyNextDown 0.3.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6982', seed:s}) over many seeds: E10 and E12 always get silence together (never exactly one)

summary: enemyBelowTarget/enemyAboveTarget return [] once the chosen target died earlier in the same cast (targeting.ts anchors on the chosen unit's formation index and bails out if it is not found). Native 9385: Damage@FromTarget then CauseBleed@BelowTarget; enemies below a killed target should still be Bled. Anchor should use the target's slot at selection time (or keep defeated units as anchors).
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1605', enemies: 4 x {hp:1,maxHp:1,armor:0}}) -> dmg E11 25; defeat E11; no Bleed on E12/E13 (L10 bleeds both)

summary: Modifier source boardSpecial has no colour filter, so native CountGems Dragon<Color> (R009: dragonGem carries its base colour) cannot be expressed. Curated 9527 (DragonBlue x8) and 9494 (DragonPurple x6), 9532 (DragonRed x6) count every Blue/Purple/Red gem instead (L10 Luther deals 100 = 12 + 8 x 11). Needs boardSpecial { gem, color? } (and the same for Giant<Color> counts); then curated switches to { kind:'boardSpecial', gem:'dragonGem', color }.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7626'}) on the default board (no Dragon gems) -> dmg 100 to all; expected 12

summary: No modifier source counts statuses on the target itself (native CountSpecificStatusEffect@FromTarget, one step per status, each adding 1). enemyStatusCount counts enemies across the team; condBonus+anyOf adds the bonus once. Royal Assassin 8417 (+10 each for Poison/Disease/Stun/Curse on the target) uses enemyStatusCount (wrong: other enemies' statuses count); Elemental Reach 8640 (+12 each for Entangle/Burning/Frozen/Stun on the target) uses condBonus anyOf (max +12). Need e.g. { kind:'targetStatusCount', statusIds:[...] } = number of listed statuses the damage target has.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1427', enemies: E11 with burning+frozen}) -> 13+12=25, expected 13+24=37; castSpell({key:'troop:6936', enemies: E10 poisoned, E11 clean}) -> 23, expected 13

summary: casterStatBeatsTarget/targetStatBeatsCaster read castTracking.lastTarget, which is unset before the first targeting segment. Native 9291 compares Armor with the chosen target first (CountSet@FromTarget [AddForLessArmorOnTarget] -> Barrier@Self) and only then deals damage; curated has to put Barrier after the hit, so the comparison uses the target's post-damage Armor (default scene: E11 armor 10 -> 0, caster 0 vs 0). Need the compare conditions to fall back to the chosen target (ctx.chosenTargetId) when no lastTarget exists, then curated moves Barrier before the damage.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7533', caster:{armor:5}}) -> E11 armor 10 before, 0 after the 32 hit -> Barrier granted; native: 5 < 10 -> no Barrier

summary: allyStatusCount has no excludeSelf option, so native CountSpecificStatusEffect@AllAlliesButNotSelf (Immortal Khaomani 9808: 'other Allies ... who are Blessed' x1.5) counts a Blessed caster too. Need allyStatusCount { statusId, excludeSelf?: true } (allyStatSum already has excludeSelf).
